Behest signed a receipt for exactly the cart PayPal captured, and its purchase log records each step.","claims":[{"text":"The buyer confirmed the spending mandate in their own words, and Behest signed it before the purchase was made.","evidenceIds":["mandate"]},{"text":"Behest enforced the limits the buyer confirmed in the readback of that mandate.","evidenceIds":["readback","purchase_log"]},{"text":"The cart lists the seller, the items, their quantities and prices, and the total that was bought.","evidenceIds":["cart"]},{"text":"Behest signed a receipt over that cart when PayPal captured the payment, and anyone can verify it with Behest's public key.","evidenceIds":["receipt","cart"]},{"text":"The purchase log records every step of the purchase in order, with times in UTC.","evidenceIds":["purchase_log"]}]}
